description: This file defines a PreviewParameterProvider for providing sample data of SearchResultUiState for use in composable previews in an Android application. It supplies a sequence of SearchResultUiState.Success instances with sample topics and news resources.

classes.name: SearchUiStatePreviewParameterProvider
classes.description: Provides sample SearchResultUiState data sequences for composable previews.

methods.name: override val values
methods.description: Returns a sequence of SearchResultUiState.Success instances with sample topics and news resources.
